lesson.subtitle: Lesson 3 -- What Have You Been Up To?
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ana Luiza Sellmann | Lesson 3 -- What Have You Been Up To?

listenings.text: Ana, it's Mom. I've been trying to call you all morning, so I'm giving up and leaving this. Nothing is wrong, do not worry. It has been raining here for four days and your brother has been complaining about it non stop, so honestly, that is the news. I've been going to the tai chi group every Saturday and I've made two friends, which at my age is a lot of work. Oh, and I've been reading that book you sent me. It is taking me ages, but it is worth it. Call me when you can. Not at three in the morning this time.

Hi Ana, it's Daniel from production. Quick one before your day starts. We've been waiting for the client's feedback since Tuesday and it still has not come, so the whole schedule has moved. I've been coordinating with the venue team all week and they have been very patient, but they need an answer by Friday. Nobody has missed the deadline yet, and I would like to keep it that way. If you have been talking to the client directly, tell me, because I do not want to send two different messages. Thanks.

extra_audio.text: Marcus says they have not spoken for ages and asks what Ana has been up to. Ana answers that she has been working like crazy and has just finished a big project. Marcus explains that he has been living in Berlin for two years and is still learning German. Ana asks him if he has been enjoying it. Marcus admits it has been exhausting, but it has been worth it.
